title: Toy Shops May Get Tax Breaks
story: Toy shops might have to pay less money to the town for having a store. This means they might save money and use it to make more toys.
storyBig: Toy shops may benefit from a new system that reduces the taxes they pay to operate in town. This could allow them to allocate more resources to expand their toy lines and improve store facilities.
think: How might lower taxes help a toy shop grow?
bull: Shops save money, which might mean more toys!
bear: If taxes are too low, there might be less money for community parks.

title: New Coins Make Spending Fun!
story: A new type of shiny coin is being used for buying things. Kids might find them in their piggy banks or when buying candy!
storyBig: New coins with unique designs are being introduced, enhancing the excitement of collecting and spending money. This could spark more interest in savings and spending among young consumers.
bull: New coins are exciting and fun to collect!
bear: It might get confusing at first with new coins.
